pre_backup_script.name: Copy the Vaultwarden database
pre_backup_script.description: Ask Vaultwarden for a consistent copy of its database, keep the newest three, and stop the backup if no copy from the last hour exists.

notes: Before each backup, Borg UI runs `/vaultwarden backup` in the Vaultwarden container. It writes db_<date>.sqlite3 next to db.sqlite3; the live file is not safe to copy while Vaultwarden runs. Needs Vaultwarden 1.32.1 or newer and SQLite (the default).
To restore, stop Vaultwarden, rename the newest db_<date>.sqlite3 to db.sqlite3, and delete any db.sqlite3-wal next to it.

If Borg UI talks to Docker through a socket proxy, it needs exec allowed. Without the container, schedule `docker exec vaultwarden /vaultwarden backup` yourself: the check only looks for a copy from the last hour.
